title: WatchDog Mermaid Metadata
description: Node and edge configuration shared by Mermaid pipelines and the node tester.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URI used by editors. VS Code already associates every *.meta.json file through .vscode/settings.json, so repository files may omit this property.

nodes.description: Node settings keyed by node ID.

additionalProperties.description: Configuration for the Mermaid node named by this object key.

edges.description: Optional edge settings keyed as FromNode->ToNode. Each key must match an edge in the adjacent Mermaid file. Unlisted edges use the next transition type.
edges.markdownDescription: Optional edge settings keyed as `FromNode->ToNode`, matching an edge in the adjacent Mermaid file. Omit `edge_type` for `next`; use `error` for the failure path. Omitting `edges` is equivalent to `{}`.

additionalProperties.description: Configuration for the Mermaid edge named by this FromNode->ToNode key.

propertyNames.description: An exact Mermaid edge key in FromNode->ToNode form. Node IDs may contain letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens, but must start with a letter or underscore.

defaultSnippets.label: Configure Mermaid edge
defaultSnippets.description: Configure an edge whose endpoints exist in the adjacent Mermaid file.

point.description: A capture-local point in [x, y] form.

prefixItems.title: x
prefixItems.description: Horizontal coordinate in captured-image pixels, measured from the left edge.

prefixItems.title: y
prefixItems.description: Vertical coordinate in captured-image pixels, measured from the top edge.

region.description: A capture-local rectangle in [x, y, width, height] form.

prefixItems.title: x
prefixItems.description: Horizontal coordinate of the rectangle's top-left corner in captured-image pixels.

prefixItems.title: y
prefixItems.description: Vertical coordinate of the rectangle's top-left corner in captured-image pixels.

roi.description: Recognition region [x, y, width, height]. [0, 0, 0, 0] means the complete captured image.

prefixItems.title: x
prefixItems.description: Horizontal start of the recognition area in captured-image pixels.

prefixItems.title: y
prefixItems.description: Vertical start of the recognition area in captured-image pixels.

prefixItems.title: width
prefixItems.description: Recognition-area width in captured-image pixels. Use 0 with an all-zero ROI to select the full image.

prefixItems.title: height
prefixItems.description: Recognition-area height in captured-image pixels. Use 0 with an all-zero ROI to select the full image.

regionOffset.description: Offset [x, y, width, height] added to the source region.

prefixItems.title: x offset
prefixItems.description: Pixels added to the source region's x coordinate.

prefixItems.title: y offset
prefixItems.description: Pixels added to the source region's y coordinate.

prefixItems.title: width offset
prefixItems.description: Pixels added to the source region's width.

prefixItems.title: height offset
prefixItems.description: Pixels added to the source region's height.

rgb.description: RGB color as [red, green, blue], with each channel from 0 to 255.

captureTarget.title: Capture target
captureTarget.description: Overrides the pipeline's current capture source for one node. Choose a screen by capture API index or a window by regular-expression filters.

oneOf.title: Screen
oneOf.description: Capture an entire physical monitor. The index is the position returned by the capture API, not a Windows display number.

type.description: Selects screen capture for this target.

index.description: Screen index returned by the capture API.

oneOf.title: Window
oneOf.description: Capture the first executable window that matches every supplied regular-expression filter. At least one filter is required.

type.description: Selects window capture for this target.

process.description: Rust regular expression matched against the executable process name. Combined with class and title using AND when multiple filters are supplied.

class.description: Rust regular expression matched against the native window class. Combined with process and title using AND when multiple filters are supplied.

title.description: Rust regular expression matched against the window title. Use ^...$ for an exact title; combined with process and class using AND.

oneOf.description: Capture DWM window bounds including the title bar, borders, and client content.
Capture only the drawable client content, excluding the title bar and non-client borders.

capture_area.description: frame captures the complete DWM window bounds, including non-client borders and title bar; client captures only the client content area. Omitted values use frame for compatibility.

candidateSelection.title: Recognition candidate selection
candidateSelection.description: Sorts all eligible recognizer results and selects one zero-based candidate. Supported by TemplateMatch, OCR, and Custom recognizers; ignored by DirectHit and ColorMatch.

oneOf.description: Keep the order returned by the recognizer.
Sort by candidate center y ascending, then center x ascending, then original detection index.
Sort by candidate center y descending, then center x ascending, then original detection index.
Sort by candidate center x ascending, then center y ascending, then original detection index.
Sort by candidate center x descending, then center y ascending, then original detection index.
Sort by confidence descending, then original detection index.

order.description: How eligible candidates are sorted before selecting index: native preserves recognizer order; vertical and horizontal modes sort by position with deterministic secondary axes; confidence_desc selects highest confidence first.

recognition.title: Recognition
recognition.description: Determines whether the node matches the captured frame and, when applicable, provides a detected box used by actions. roi, roi_offset, and candidate_selection belong inside this object.

oneOf.title: Direct hit
oneOf.description: Always matches; useful when an action uses a fixed target.

roi.description: Recognition area in captured-image pixels. DirectHit returns this area as its recognized box; omitted or [0,0,0,0] uses the whole image.

roi_offset.description: Offset applied to roi before recognition.

candidate_selection.description: Candidate selection configuration. DirectHit returns one implicit region and ignores this field.

oneOf.title: Template match
oneOf.description: Find image regions similar to a template image, filter them by threshold, then optionally sort and select one candidate.

template.description: Template image path. Absolute paths are used directly. Relative paths first check %USERPROFILE%/.watch_dog/resources/images and then the project's bundled resources/images directory.

threshold.description: Minimum normalized template-match confidence from 0 to 1. Omitted values use 0.7.

roi.description: Area searched for template candidates. Coordinates are local to the captured image; omitted or [0,0,0,0] searches the whole image.

roi_offset.description: Offset applied to roi before recognition.

candidate_selection.description: Sort and zero-based index used to choose one eligible template candidate. Omitted values preserve native order and choose index 0.

oneOf.title: OCR
oneOf.description: Recognize text blocks, filter by confidence and the optional expected regular expression, then optionally sort and select one block.

expected.description: Regex matched against each OCR block. Unanchored patterns search by substring; use ^...$ for an exact block match. Literal spaces tolerate spaces omitted by OCR.

roi.description: Area submitted to OCR. Coordinates are local to the captured image; omitted or [0,0,0,0] uses the whole image.

roi_offset.description: Offset applied to roi before recognition.

candidate_selection.description: Sort and zero-based index used to choose one OCR block after confidence and expected-text filtering. Omitted values preserve native order and choose index 0.

oneOf.title: Color match
oneOf.description: Match when pixels inside the recognition area fall within the inclusive RGB range. The recognized box is the effective ROI.

roi.description: Area whose pixels are checked for the requested color range. Omitted or [0,0,0,0] uses the whole image.

roi_offset.description: Offset applied to roi before recognition.

candidate_selection.description: Reserved for recognizers that return multiple candidates. ColorMatch currently ignores this field.

oneOf.title: Custom recognizer
oneOf.description: Invoke a recognizer registered by the engine and pass recognizer-specific JSON parameters.

roi.description: Area passed to the custom recognizer. Omitted or [0,0,0,0] uses the whole image.

roi_offset.description: Offset applied to roi before recognition.

candidate_selection.description: Sort and zero-based index used when the custom recognizer returns candidate regions. Omitted values preserve native order and choose index 0.

actionTarget.title: Action target
actionTarget.description: true uses the recognized box; a string references a previous node; [x,y] is a fixed point; [x,y,width,height] is a fixed area.

oneOf.title: Recognized box
oneOf.description: Use the current node's recognized box as the action target. The action starts at the box center after applying its offset.

oneOf.title: Node ID
oneOf.description: Use the recognized box saved under the named node ID. The current node and any earlier node that matched in this run are available.
Use a fixed capture-local [x,y] point as the action target.
Use a fixed capture-local [x,y,width,height] area; the action starts at its center.

action.title: Action
action.description: An operation executed after the node matches. Actions run in array order; target-based actions map capture-local coordinates to physical screen coordinates.

oneOf.title: Do nothing
oneOf.description: Perform no input. Useful for recognition-only nodes, delays, and graph transitions.

oneOf.title: Click
oneOf.description: Click the center of the resolved target after applying target_offset.

target.description: Area or point to click. Omitted values use the current recognized box.

target_offset.description: Offset added to the resolved target before its center is clicked. Omitted values use [0,0,0,0].

oneOf.title: Long press
oneOf.description: Press and hold at the center of the resolved target for duration milliseconds.

target.description: Area or point at which to press. Omitted values use the current recognized box.

target_offset.description: Offset added to the resolved target before pressing its center. Omitted values use [0,0,0,0].

duration.description: How long to hold the pointer down, in milliseconds. Omitted values use 1000.

oneOf.title: Swipe
oneOf.description: Drag from the center of begin to the center of end over duration milliseconds.

begin.description: Swipe start area or point. Omitted values use the current recognized box.

begin_offset.description: Offset added to begin before resolving the swipe start center. Omitted values use [0,0,0,0].

end.description: Swipe destination area or point. Omitted values use the current recognized box.

end_offset.description: Offset added to end before resolving the swipe destination center. Omitted values use [0,0,0,0].

duration.description: Swipe duration in milliseconds. Omitted values use 200.

oneOf.title: Scroll
oneOf.description: Move the pointer to the resolved target, then emit horizontal and vertical wheel deltas.

target.description: Area or point over which scrolling occurs. Omitted values use the current recognized box.

target_offset.description: Offset added to the resolved target before moving to its center. Omitted values use [0,0,0,0].

dx.description: Horizontal wheel delta. Positive scrolls right; negative scrolls left; omitted values use 0.

dy.description: Vertical scroll amount. Positive scrolls down; negative scrolls up.

oneOf.title: Press keyboard key
oneOf.description: Press one or more native platform key codes in the listed order.

key.description: One or more native platform key codes pressed in array order.

oneOf.title: Input text
oneOf.description: Type text into the currently focused control after substituting pipeline parameters.

input_text.description: Text to type. {{parameter}} placeholders are substituted before execution.

oneOf.title: Stop pipeline
oneOf.description: Stop the current pipeline successfully after reaching this action.

oneOf.title: Custom action
oneOf.description: Invoke an action registered by the engine and pass action-specific JSON parameters.

parameter.title: Developer input parameter
parameter.description: Declares one field shown by the node tester. The entered value is available to actions through {{key}} placeholders.

oneOf.description: Single-line visible text input.
Single-line masked text input.
Numeric input whose value is stored as a number.
Select control populated from options.
Boolean on/off control.
Color picker whose value is stored as a color string.

type.description: Control displayed by the pipeline tester.

placeholder.description: Hint shown when the tester input is empty. Omitted values use an empty string.

default.description: Initial value; use string, number, or boolean according to the parameter type.

options.description: Choices shown for a dropdown parameter. Other control types ignore this list; omitted values use an empty array.

nodeFields.description: All supported metadata fields for one Mermaid node.

recognition.description: Recognizer configuration used to decide whether this node matches. The engine default is DirectHit, but metadata files require this field explicitly for readability.

items.description: One action executed after a successful node match.

actions.description: Actions executed in array order after recognition and pre_delay. Omitted values perform no actions.

items.description: One developer-editable input exposed by the node tester.

params.description: Developer input fields for this node. Values can be substituted into supported action strings with {{key}}; omitted values expose no fields.

target.description: Transient capture-source override used only while this node runs. It does not overwrite the user's persisted manual capture preference.

timeout.description: Reserved retry timeout in milliseconds. The current streaming runner keeps this value for compatibility but does not enforce node-level retries.

rate_limit.description: Reserved delay between recognition retries in milliseconds. The current streaming runner keeps this value for compatibility but evaluates once per graph visit.

pre_delay.description: Delay after successful recognition and before the first action, in milliseconds. Omitted values use 200.

post_delay.description: Delay after the node's actions finish, in milliseconds. It also runs after an action error; omitted values use 200.

enabled.description: Whether this node is executable. A disabled node skips capture, recognition, and actions and immediately follows its next edge.

max_hit.description: Maximum number of successful executions during one pipeline run. Once reached, later visits skip the node and follow its next edge; omitted values are effectively unlimited.

repeat.description: Number of times each individual action is executed before advancing to the next action. Use 0 to execute each action once because the initial execution always occurs; omitted values use 1.

repeat_delay.description: Delay between repetitions of the same action, in milliseconds. Omitted values use 0.

attach.description: Arbitrary JSON metadata retained with the node for application-specific use. The pipeline engine does not interpret it.

nodeMetadata.title: Pipeline node metadata
nodeMetadata.description: Configuration for a node whose key exactly matches a node ID in the adjacent Mermaid flow file.

edgeMetadata.title: Mermaid edge metadata
edgeMetadata.description: Optional execution behavior for one edge declared in the adjacent Mermaid flow file.

oneOf.description: Follow this edge after a successful match and successful actions, or when a node is disabled or has reached max_hit.
Follow this edge when capture, recognition, candidate selection, or action execution fails or does not match.

edge_type.description: Normal transition or transition used when recognition or an action fails.
